name: Not Good Enough
overview: The Scriptures reveal that no person is inherently righteous or 'good enough' on their own, as Romans 3:10 declares that there is none righteous, not even one. Yet, God’s intimate knowledge and care for us, shown in Psalms 139:13 and His sovereign plans for our good in Jeremiah 29:11, assure us of His purpose and presence. Through faith in Christ, who was given by God out of love for the world (John 3:16), believers are called to courage and strength, trusting that the Lord is with them wherever they go (Joshua 1:9), even when they feel inadequate.
